## Visual Storyboard

### Part A: 主视觉 cover-main (2.35:1)
(IP形象: 否)
```
movie composition, 2.35:1 aspect ratio. Flat vector illustration, sticker style with thick white outlines. A glowing purple folder icon in the center of the frame, labeled with a small star symbol. Three colorful translucent arrows radiate outward from the folder: one electric blue arrow pointing upper-right to a terminal window icon, one warm orange arrow pointing right to a code editor icon, one teal arrow pointing lower-right to a command-line prompt icon. Each target icon is rendered as a semi-transparent ghost outline, implying they are references not copies. Clean white background, minimal geometric shapes, modern tech aesthetic. Color palette: deep purple center, electric blue, warm orange, teal accents. No text, no characters. --ar 2.35:1
```

### Part C: 内文配图 illustration
#### 插图 1: 三套目录的混乱
(IP形象: 否)
```
portrait composition, 3:4 aspect ratio. Flat vector illustration, sticker style with thick white outlines. Three separate floating file cabinet drawers arranged in a row, each a different color (purple, orange, teal). Inside each drawer, identical-looking document folders are visible, but their arrangement is slightly different — one has a newer folder the others lack, one has an outdated label. Small red exclamation marks float above two of the cabinets. Clean white background, soft shadows. Conveys redundancy and version mismatch. No characters, no text. --ar 3:4
```
> Context: "改一个地方，要改三处。这事我忍了大概两天。"

#### 插图 2: 唯一真源的秩序感
(IP形象: 否)
```
portrait composition, 3:4 aspect ratio. Flat vector illustration, sticker style with thick white outlines. One solid purple filing cabinet in the center, glowing subtly, with a small crown icon on top. Two dotted-line arrows extend from it: one to a blue ghost-outline cabinet on the left, one to an orange ghost-outline cabinet on the right. The ghost cabinets are semi-transparent, clearly showing they are linked references. Small green checkmarks float above all three. Clean white background, geometric, satisfying symmetry. No characters, no text. --ar 3:4
```
> Context: "文件在磁盘上，就能用软链接。"

#### 插图 3: 一键同步的从容
(IP形象: 是)
```
portrait composition, 3:4 aspect ratio. Flat vector illustration, sticker style with thick white outlines. A bald Asian male (early 30s), wearing signature bright red round-framed glasses, neat goatee beard on chin, character has thick white outlines around the entire silhouette (sticker style). He is sitting relaxed in a chair, one hand casually pressing a single large purple button on a minimal desk. From the button, three small colorful paper airplanes (purple, blue, orange) fly outward in different directions, each trailing a dotted line. His expression is calm and satisfied. Clean white background, minimal furniture. --ar 3:4
```
> Context: "我用的是 Raycast 来触发，但这不是唯一的方式。你可以用 Alfred、用 Shell alias、用 cron 定时任务，甚至直接手动跑脚本——选自己顺手的就好。"
